issues.description: Behavior change: empty base_image now resolves to python:3.12 instead of KFP default
issues.detail: In backend/kale/pipeline.py _set_base_image, the fallback changed from self.base_image = "" to DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE. The prior comment explicitly said 'Use kfp default image'. This silently changes runtime image for pods where podutils failed, potentially breaking pipelines that relied on KFP's own default. Worth calling out in release notes or reverting that line if the intent was UI-only.

issues.description: Duplicated DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE constant across Python and TS with hardcoded fallbacks
issues.detail: python:3.12 is now defined in pipeline.py, hardcoded again in Commands.ts getDefaultBaseImage catch, exported as DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE in CellMetadataEditor.tsx, and referenced in the Jinja template. Drift is inevitable next bump. Consider sourcing the TS constant only from the RPC and removing the literal duplicates, or at least a single TS constant.

issues.description: IMAGE button hides the currently configured base image from inline view
issues.detail: The old Input showed the per-step baseImage value at a glance. The new tiny 'IMAGE' button reveals nothing without clicking. Users editing many cells lose scannability. Consider showing a truncated current value on/next to the button (e.g., 'IMAGE: python:3.11') so users can see overrides without opening each dialog.

issues.description: Button disabled when stepName empty silently blocks editing existing image
issues.detail: The IMAGE button is disabled unless stepName length > 0, but there is no tooltip/explanation and the old Input had no such restriction. A user who clears the step name temporarily, or a merged/reserved step, may be unable to view or reset the base image. At minimum surface a reason in the title attribute.

issues.description: Inline 'Base Image: ... (default)' now renders for every step, increasing visual noise
issues.detail: Previously createBaseImageText returned '' when no override was set. Now every step cell shows 'Base Image: python:3.12 (default)'. On notebooks with many steps this clutters the inline metadata strip. Consider keeping the line hidden unless a custom or pipeline-level image is set, or making it visually subdued.

issues.description: Button width:'5%' inside a flex/inline layout is fragile
issues.detail: style={{ width: '5%' }} on the MUI Button rarely behaves predictably across panel widths and will likely clip the 'IMAGE' label or stretch oddly. Prefer letting MUI size the button to content, or use a fixed min-width matching the other inputs.

review.summary: The PR threads a server-provided default base image through the labextension UI and template, which is a reasonable feature. The most consequential concern is a quiet backend behavior change in pipeline._set_base_image where the empty-string fallback (KFP default) is replaced with python:3.12, which can change runtime images for existing users. Secondary concerns are the duplicated default constant in multiple places, and UX regressions in the cell editor: a tiny IMAGE button that hides the currently set value, an unexplained disabled state, and added noise from always showing the default image inline.
